BIRDMOD-DAGGER_EVENT.pages.ORNATE.descri:
You took the dagger, twirling it in your talons.
You would make your [shake rate=20.0 level=8 connected=0][outline_size=8][outline_color=dark_orange]Ancestors[/outline_color][/outline_size][/shake] proud.
BIRDMOD-DAGGER_EVENT.pages.PLAIN.descrip:
You shut your eyes, and with a sharp intake of breath, you gave some of your blood to the basin.

Leaving the Dagger behind, you continue on your way. As you go to leave, though, your foot strikes a rock, and you let out a squeak.
The rock had been pushed aside, and underneath it was...

[jitter][gold]MONEY!!![/gold][/jitter]
BIRDMOD-DAGGER_EVENT.title: Ruined Ritual Site
BIRDMOD-DAGGER_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.descr:
You stumble upon what looks like...
[jitter]Oh.[/jitter]
It looks like... one of your tribe's ritual sites, from outside the Spire, but...
[sine]Why would it be here? And... why is it...[/sine] [red]destroyed?[/red]

You knowingly search the Ritual site, and come upon the Dagger you [jitter]knew[/jitter] would be hidden underneath a basin, as cracked and toppled it may be.


You could preform a small ritual yourself, for good fortune, or take the Dagger with you... potentially [sine]empowering[/sine] it?
BIRDMOD-IMBUE_EVENT.pages.ORNATE.descrip:
Following the mysterious pull, you searched through the nearby rubble until you came across...
A gray, almost colorless feather of some kind?

It seems familiar, but you can't quite place it... either way, it seems [sine]special[/sine]
Shaking your head to clear your thoughts, you store the feather and continue on your way.
BIRDMOD-IMBUE_EVENT.pages.PLAIN.descript:
You ignored the camp and kept walking.
Couldn't have been [i]that[/i] important.
BIRDMOD-IMBUE_EVENT.title: Abandoned Camp
BIRDMOD-IMBUE_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.descri:
You come across what looks like an [sine]abandoned camp site[/sine].
Curiously, something in some nearby rubble feels like it's [jitter]pulling[/jitter] at you...

Though, the feeling is elusive and hard to place, of course.
BIRDMOD-REFLECTION_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.d:
You come across... [sine]yourself?[/sine]

The other you seems surprised to see you, too.

She braces for a fight...
BIRDMOD-REFLECTION_EVENT.title: It's You
BIRDMOD-DAGGER_EVENT.pages.RUN.descripti:
You turned tail and ran away from yourself.
There's probably something poetic about that.
BIRDMOD-REFLECTION_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.o:
Begin an [red][jitter]extremely[/jitter][/red] difficult encounter for a [sine]special[/sine] reward.
[font_size=14]Very buggy. Probably not worth it. Please give it a shot anyway.[/font_size]
